text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Above the age of 18 and under the age of 30 3. Those who apply for the study of liberal arts and have passed at least HSK Examination Band 6, can directly start their study in the relevant colleges or departments; those who fail to pass the examination can at first apply for their study of Chinese Language for one year in Wuhan University before their study in the relevant colleges or departments.
